text:
Ava (Marketing): Heads up — we need a paid push for the 'Scaling Inference' webinar next Thu. Two asks: 1) refresh retargeting creative (hero/CTA swap), 2) tighten budget pacing for last 72h pre-webinar. Brief below.

Priya (Paid): Budget check — current run-rate: search ~$1.8k/day, retarget ~$600/day. Target = 150 net signups/day during promo. Proposal: shift 20% of search budget to retarget 72h before webinar, then +25% bids final 24h. Thoughts? :calendar: :rocket:

Eli (Analytics): Snapshot from last 48h: total spend $2.4k/day, overall CVR 2.1%, CPL $45, retarget CPL $28. Dashboard -> https://redwood.ai/ads/dashboards/webinar (perm link)

Jamal (Growth): +1 to re-allocating. Also want to run an RSA headline test: CTA A = "Start with free credits" vs CTA B = "See inference savings". Keep creative A/B across search and retarget.

Sophia (Creative): I uploaded two hero assets to the library: webinar-heroA.png (product-first) and webinar-heroB.png (ROI-first). Will add alt copy for both CTAs. Suggest swap schedule: deploy B at T-48h, then revert A at T-12h if B underperforms.

Priya (Paid): Retargeting window suggestion: 30d -> 14d for baseline, but make a 7d high-intent segment (page view + event 'pricing_click') and bid that up. Exclusions: exclude existing demo/enterprise leads and current customers.

Ava (Marketing): Routing: tag all webinar signups with utm_id=paid-webinar-2026 and route to webinars@redwood.ai. If lead score > 60, auto-forward to AE queue. Also add property "source=paid-webinar" to CRM event.

Priya (Paid): UTM template I'm going to use for final assets (insert as-is into Google ads):
```
https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=scaling-inference&utm_content={creative}&utm_term={keyword}&utm_id=paid-webinar-2026-03-28
```
Make sure post-click parameters are preserved for GTM.

Jamal (Growth): For bids: 20% shift to retarget for T-72->T-24. Final 24h: +25% multiplier for high-intent keywords, cap broad-match bids -15% to avoid waste. Set campaign-level fallback to conservative CPA of $60.

campaign-bot: Campaign snapshot (automated): "Search - scaling-inference" status: active, daily cap $1800, retargeting-list size 42,300, last 24h conversions 32, avg CPL $44.

Priya (Paid): I'll implement these changes. Plan to push creative swap at 2026-03-26T08:00:00-07:00 (PT) for T-48h run, and then schedule final bid multipliers at 2026-03-27T08:00:00-07:00. Will post logs here when live.

Ava (Marketing): Great. Sophia — can you also provide ad copy variants (short headlines + description) that call out "predictable latency" and "unit cost savings"? Jamal — please prepare the KPI dashboard widget for the 72h window (CPL, CVR, CPA by audience).

Sophia (Creative): Copy options added to the library:
- H1: "Run inference reliably — scale with predictable cost"
- H2: "Reduce per-token cost — learn how at the webinar"
- Desc1: "Join our engineers for a hands-on guide to inference scaling. Free credits included."
- Desc2: "See real benchmarks: latency, throughput, and cost-saving tips."

Eli (Analytics): I'll surface a 6-hour cadence alert if CPL > $80 or spend pacing is >110% of expected.

Priya (Paid): Implemented initial bid shifts and uploaded creative. Rolling changes now, ETA ~10m. Will report back with first-hour performance. :white_check_mark:

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team — please keep updates brief here. If any surprises, escalate to #release-war-room.

campaign-bot: Update: creative webinar-heroB.png published to audiences; bid changes applied (request id 9f3a)."
